description: INROLE asks for a role of the app the formula belongs to (ADR-0100). The role is written as text, never worked out, and the app must name it, whatever the case of the name; it is a context function, which an auto formula may not call. A formula of no app has no roles: conformance/binding/roles-no-app.json.
